description: This file defines the Client class and related enums and structures for managing D-Bus communication in a process container environment, including app state management, threading, and connection handling.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Manages D-Bus connections, app state changes, and container control for process containers.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Abstract interface for container control, with methods for handling state changes and starting/stopping containers.

classes.name: ThreadGuard
classes.description: Utility class to manage thread lifecycle, ensuring thread joins on destruction.

methods.name: toStr
methods.description: Converts AppState enum values to their string representations.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates the client connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a shared interface to the client.

methods.name: unbind
methods.description: Unbinds a shared interface from the client.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the D-Bus signal.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous result with a timeout.

methods.name: connectionResetIfNeeded
methods.description: Resets the connection if needed, with a default timeout.

methods.name: connectBus
methods.description: Connects to the D-Bus bus with a timeout.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the main loop or processing.

methods.name: findInterface
methods.description: Finds an interface by its string identifier.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Quits the client, closing connections and cleaning up.
